verdict.rationale: An auth service could plausibly offer AI-generated insights on its own data, such as sign-in patterns or security suggestions, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents only authentication features (OAuth, MFA, SSO, JWTs, hooks, sessions) and machine-readable docs (llms.txt, OpenAPI). None of it shows in-product AI-generated insights or suggestions, and machine-readable docs are an adjacent feature, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
